query: What booking links can VoyageFlow generate?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow generates a structured Booking Demand Card that includes a hotel search link pre-filled with destination, check-in date, check-out date, and guest count [voyageflow-overview::003]. It also generates a flight search link pre-filled with origin airport, destination airport, and travel dates [voyageflow-overview::003]. Additionally, VoyageFlow can generate an activities/experiences link via GetYourGuide or Viator when relevant [voyageflow-overview::003]. These links are deep-linked search URLs, not confirmed bookings, and users must complete their reservation on the destination platform [voyageflow-overview::003]. VoyageFlow supports partner platforms such as Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda for hotels, and Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak for flights [voyageflow-overview::002].

citations.claim: VoyageFlow generates a structured Booking Demand Card.
The Booking Demand Card contains a hotel search link pre-filled with destination, check-in date, check-out date, and guest count.
It also includes a flight search link pre-filled with origin airport, destination airport, and travel dates.
An activities/experiences link (via GetYourGuide or Viator) is generated when relevant.
These links are deep-linked search URLs, not confirmed bookings.
Users must complete their reservation on the destination platform.
VoyageFlow surfaces hotel recommendations and generates deep booking links to partner platforms including Booking.com, Expedia, and Agoda.
VoyageFlow generates flight search links to supported partners including Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak.
